mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_mails WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_mails (id, user_id, tag, subject, excerpt, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tag}, #{subject}, #{excerpt}, #{isRead}, #{createdAt})
